name: Olivia Voldaren
aliases: Lady of our most illustrious house
description: Olivia Voldaren is the ancient vampire progenitor of the Voldaren line on Innistrad, a vain noblewoman who seeks to become Lord of Innistrad.

description_citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

summary.text: Olivia Voldaren is the ancient vampire progenitor of the Voldaren line on Innistrad, a vain noblewoman who seeks to become Lord of Innistrad.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Sorin came to her masked ballroom for help; she mocked him but agreed to help on the condition that he first help her.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

bio.text: She rejoiced that Avacyn was dead and led the Voldaren vampire army with Sorin to battle Nahiri, then taunted Sorin, declared the bargain fulfilled and left him trapped in stone.

citations.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

bio.text: She agreed a truce with Thalia against the horrors and then stabbed Seeta from behind.

citations.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citations.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

citations.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citations.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Years later she let the humans' Harvesttide festival proceed, then seized Katilda and took the Moonsilver Key from Arlinn.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.
"Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.
"Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

bio.text: She demanded a nightly blood tithe and staged a political wedding to Edgar Markov, planning to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the key.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

citations.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries

"Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

bio.text: The wedding was ruined when cathars and geists attacked, and she fled and fought Arlinn, striking her down with a stake.

citations.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.
"Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

status.text: As of the latest story Olivia is alive, having dropped the Moonsilver Key and fled when Arlinn and her wolves cornered her with Edgar.

citations.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citations.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
timeline.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
timeline.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
timeline.quote: I have come for your help.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
timeline.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
timeline.quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
timeline.quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: A vampire priest turns Liliana away until Olivia appears and welcomes her.
timeline.quote: Oh Liliana, my dear one!

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
timeline.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
timeline.quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
timeline.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
timeline.quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
timeline.quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
timeline.quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
timeline.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
timeline.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Weeks after the Harvesttide Massacre, Grigori draws blood from his sleeping mother to meet Olivia Voldaren's tithe decree.
timeline.quote: Grigori presses the knife to his mother's wrist.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia's decree demands one bowl of blood from every resident each night until the festivities.
timeline.quote: one bowl of blood from each resident, once a night until the festivities

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
timeline.quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren makes a grand entrance, announces the wedding and has thralls carry in a coffin for the groom.
timeline.quote: an elaborate stone coffin: marble inlaid with gold, crowned by Markovian rays

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
timeline.quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
timeline.quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
timeline.quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin charges at Olivia, killing one guard and freezing two, but is bound with Blessed Silver chains by the guards.
timeline.quote: When Sorin pounces on one, he tears out their throat before the two of them even hit the ground.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.
timeline.quote: "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia wakes other Markov ancients for the groom's side, and Sorin's family passes him by without a word.
timeline.quote: A few drops is all it takes to start the process of waking the ancients.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
timeline.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
timeline.quote: I have a little something else planned first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
timeline.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
timeline.quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
timeline.quote: A blade of red-black slices through the chains as easily as any sword.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A flash of light throws off Sorin's cut, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: Grasping for the now-falling key, Olivia is furious.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.
timeline.quote: this is someone's spirit, separated from their body.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
timeline.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Cathars crash through the windows and the crowd demands the key; Olivia rages at the destruction of her wedding.
timeline.quote: "You . . . all of you! You're ruining my wedding day !"

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of geists materialize and attack their former oppressors, led by Katilda.
timeline.quote: There must be hundreds of them, all materializing at once

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Olivia's train, freeing the geists bound within it, and Olivia flees into a hallway.
timeline.quote: Kaya plunges a spectral dagger into Olivia's fell train.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn chases Olivia through the portrait-lined corridors and corners her in a dead end, where she claws her.
timeline.quote: With a human howl, she lashes out

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts Arlinn's fingers and stabs her chest with a gilt sword, taunting her for being alone.
timeline.quote: "You're all alone here."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn changes into her wolf form and fights Olivia, hurling her through a statue.
timeline.quote: Senses sharpen. Strength returns to her as she grows

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Distracted by tearing at the portraits, Arlinn is staked by Olivia from behind and falls.
timeline.quote: How ironic—a vampire's stiffened hand makes for an excellent stake.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her wolves track Olivia and corner her with Edgar, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees.
timeline.quote: But she drops the key.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

relations.quote: Not even Olivia's premier geist expert had been able to tame the Veil.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

relations.note: Truce between humans and vampires for the battle.
relations.quote: No human blade will harm your kind. We agree.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

relations.note: He reports to her as a servant.
relations.quote: "My most illustrious and powerful Lady Olivia Voldaren."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

relations.note: He tries to stop her wedding ritual.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

relations.quote: He'll endure anything if it means he can tear Olivia Voldaren's head from her body.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

relations.quote: fought for the dreadful privilege of marrying Olivia Voldaren

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: A powerful ancient vampire, the Voldaren progenitor with red curls who hosts lavish feasts and mocks Sorin before agreeing to help for a price.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

pages_say.description: A vampire noblewoman at Lurenbraum Fortress who rejoices at Avacyn's death and joins Sorin to fight Nahiri.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

pages_say.description: A red-haired vampire in black plate armor who aids Sorin against Nahiri and then leaves him trapped, wanting to be Lord of Innistrad.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: A powerful vampire progenitor of the Voldaren line, in battle armor with a huge hollowed blade, who forms a truce with Thalia and kills Seeta.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: A vain, murderous vampire lady who wears a flayed maiden's face and decides to let the humans' ritual proceed.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire lady who swoops down during the ritual, takes Katilda hostage and gets the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire lady who demands a nightly blood tithe from the people of Stensia and plans to wed Edgar Markov.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire lady who stages a wedding to Edgar Markov and presents herself as the new lord of Innistrad.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: The progenitor of the Voldaren line who made a pact that no vampire would draw human blood until the war was over.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire lady marrying Edgar Markov and plotting to control angels through Sigarda's blood and the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire progenitor who flees through her manor, wounds Arlinn with a sword and strikes her down.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: A vampire lady who drops the Moonsilver Key and flees through a window when the wolves arrive.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.
